## Complete Data Dictionary
```{r}
datadictionary <- tibble::tribble(
  ~group, ~variable, ~description, ~type, ~coding, ~notes,

  # ---- Survey design and identifiers -------------------------------------------------
  "Survey design and identifiers", "record_id", "Respondent ID", "Integer",
  "824 unique respondents<br>Range 4 to 1208",
  "18 rows per respondent (6 questions &times; 3 alternatives). IDs are not consecutive.",

  "Survey design and identifiers", "survey_type", "Survey version: who manages the MPA", "Integer code",
  "1 = National (central government), n = 422<br>2 = Community (local organizations), n = 402",
  "In the Japanese originals, one phrase on the Part 2 intro page is the only difference between versions.",

  "Survey design and identifiers", "SurveyNumber", "Survey block", "Integer",
  "1 to 14",
  "Each block holds six choice questions (blocked from the 81-question design).",

  "Survey design and identifiers", "QuestionNumber", "Position of the question in the survey", "Integer",
  "2 to 7",
  "Question 1 was a dummy warm-up and was dropped, leaving six per respondent.",

  "Survey design and identifiers", "ChoiceSet", "Choice-question ID within the survey versions", "Integer",
  "84 distinct values (2 to 98)",
  "14 blocks &times; 6 questions. Inferred from the data.",

  "Survey design and identifiers", "OriginalSet", "Question ID in the 81-question experimental design", "Integer",
  "1 to 81",
  "Orthogonal fractional factorial design. Coding inferred from the data.",

  "Survey design and identifiers", "Cid", "Choice-situation ID (respondent &times; question)", "Integer (stored as float)",
  "4,944 distinct values",
  "Exactly 3 rows each. Used as the choice-set identifier in the logit model.",

  "Survey design and identifiers", "record_iidd", "Row ID", "Integer (stored as float)",
  "14,832 unique values",
  "One row per respondent &times; question &times; alternative.",

  # ---- Respondent characteristics ----------------------------------------------------
  "Respondent characteristics", "gender", "Gender", "Integer code",
  "1 = Male (n = 406)<br>2 = Female (n = 418)",
  "Stored as text in the raw file. Coding confirmed by the paper's Table 2.",

  "Respondent characteristics", "age", "Age in years", "Integer",
  "19 to 56<br>Mean 41.6",
  "Top-coded: 56 means 56 or older (101 respondents). Stored as text in the raw file.",

  "Respondent characteristics", "children_HH", "Children under 18 in the household", "Integer",
  "0 to 5<br>Mean 0.79",
  "Stored as text with a leading zero (for example &quot;01&quot;) in the raw file.",

  "Respondent characteristics", "annual_income", "Annual household income category", "Ordinal code",
  "1 = under 1M yen (45)<br>2 = 1M to 2M yen (85)<br>3 = 2M to 5M yen (348)<br>4 = 5M to 7M yen (113)<br>5 = 7M yen or more (89)<br>6 = don't know / prefer not to answer (144)",
  "Code 6 is a non-response, not an income level. The paper's Table 2 means count it as 6.",

  "Respondent characteristics", "employment_status", "Employment status (choose one)", "Integer code",
  "1 = Full-time work (384)<br>2 = Part-time work (100)<br>3 = Self-employed (90)<br>4 = Full-time student (20)<br>5 = Part-time student (1)<br>6 = Full-time homemaker (133)<br>7 = Retired (19)<br>8 = Unemployed (68)<br>9 = Other (9)",
  "Labels from the Japanese survey form. The English community supplement's &quot;Recent graduate&quot; for code 6 is a translation error.",

  "Respondent characteristics", "birth_location", "Birthplace", "Integer code",
  "1 = Okinawa Prefecture (569)<br>2 = Outside Okinawa, in Japan (254)<br>3 = Overseas (1)",
  "Paper's text reports three born outside Japan; the file has one.",

  # ---- Choice attributes -------------------------------------------------------------
  "Choice attributes", "fish_catch", "Leisure fish catch after 10 years (% change)", "Numeric",
  "30, 15, 0 = MPA options<br>-15 = status quo",
  "Average catch per recreational fishing trip.",

  "Choice attributes", "coral_coverage", "Coral coverage and marine biodiversity after 10 years (% change)", "Numeric",
  "30, 15, 0 = MPA options<br>-15 = status quo",
  "Extent and health of reefs and the number of marine species.",

  "Choice attributes", "coastal_conditions", "Shoreline and coastal conditions after 10 years", "Numeric",
  "30, 15, 0 = MPA options<br>-15 = status quo",
  "Coded so higher is better: 30 means 30% less development and a more intact shoreline; -15 means 15% more development.",

  "Choice attributes", "contribution", "Monthly contribution (payment attribute), yen", "Numeric",
  "100, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000 = MPA options<br>0 = status quo",
  "Paid by all Okinawan residents. 100 yen is about 0.85 USD.",

  "Choice attributes", "ASC", "Alternative-specific constant (MPA indicator)", "Binary",
  "1 = one of the two MPA options<br>0 = no-MPA status quo",
  "Exactly one status-quo row per choice question (attributes -15, -15, -15 and payment 0).",

  # ---- Constructed in the analysis ---------------------------------------------------
  "Constructed in the analysis (not in the raw file)", "alt", "Alternative position within a choice question", "Integer",
  "1, 2 = MPA options<br>3 = status quo",
  "Created after sorting each question so the status quo is last.",

  "Constructed in the analysis (not in the raw file)", "choice", "Selected alternative", "Logical",
  "TRUE = chosen<br>FALSE = not chosen",
  "<b>Randomly generated placeholder</b>: the shared data has no choice column. Replace with real answers before reporting results.",

  "Constructed in the analysis (not in the raw file)", "community", "Community-based survey dummy", "Binary",
  "1 = survey_type 2<br>0 = survey_type 1",
  "Used to build the interaction terms in Model 2.",

  "Constructed in the analysis (not in the raw file)", "payment", "Contribution used in the models, yen", "Numeric",
  "Same values as contribution",
  "Coefficients are per yen, as in the paper.",

  "Constructed in the analysis (not in the raw file)", "fish_comm, coral_comm, coastal_comm, pay_comm, ASC_comm", "Attribute &times; community interactions", "Numeric",
  "Each attribute multiplied by community",
  "Model 2 terms.",

  "Constructed in the analysis (not in the raw file)", "gender_female, okinawa", "Indicator versions used for Table 2", "Binary",
  "gender_female = 1 if gender is 2<br>okinawa = 1 if birth_location is 1",
  "Means of these give the paper's gender and born-in-Okinawa rows.",

  "Constructed in the analysis (not in the raw file)", "income_valid", "Income with non-responses removed", "Ordinal code",
  "annual_income 1 to 5; code 6 set to missing",
  "Used for the secondary summary table."
)
```

```{r}
idx <- unique(datadictionary$group)
pack_index <- setNames(as.integer(table(factor(datadictionary$group, levels = idx))), idx)

datadictionary |>
  transmute(Variable = variable, Description = description, Type = type,
            `Values and coding` = coding, Notes = notes) |>
  kable(escape = FALSE, align = "lllll") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "hover"), full_width = TRUE,
                font_size = 13) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#1f3a5f") |>
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, monospace = TRUE, width = "11em", color = "#1f3a5f") |>
  column_spec(2, width = "15em") |>
  column_spec(3, width = "7em", color = "#555555") |>
  column_spec(4, width = "20em") |>
  column_spec(5, width = "20em", color = "#555555") |>
  pack_rows(index = pack_index, background = "#e8eef6", color = "#1f3a5f",
            bold = TRUE, label_row_css = "border-top: 2px solid #1f3a5f;")
```
